svg.text: FORMAT LINEAGE: Charlie Hills (Boris Cherny 10 Claude Code changes & 42 add-ons) • Anthropic Claude Code guide
The Claude Code Loop That Ships: Explore → Plan → Code → Commit (with the exact words to type)
Anthropic's best-practices guide + Charlie Hills's Boris Cherny 10-Change Cheatsheet (Goal + Effort + Check, /context, /loop, and 'Check it works in Chrome').

Loading the right files first and pruning stale MCP
tools with /context keeps the plan grounded.
Make it think, or Shift+Tab auto

fix the refresh race. List files to change, the

Implement the approved plan. Add the failing test
first, make it pass, run the full suite, and check
it works in Chrome before showing me the diff.
Tests + real browser verification ('Check it works
in Chrome') let the agent close the loop itself.
Commit with root cause, open a PR, and if you
fixed a recurring mistake twice, fold the rule
into CLAUDE.md or a reusable SKILL.md.
Boris Cherny's #10 rule: every repeated correction
belongs in CLAUDE.md or a skill so the next session
THINKING BUDGET DIAL (THE KEYWORDS ARE LITERAL)
Pair with /effort high for architecture planning; use Shift+Tab auto mode once CLAUDE.md + tests lock the rails.
Common bash commands (build, test, lint) + core files
Prompting formula: Goal + Effort (/effort high) + Check
Browser check: 'Check it works in Chrome' (Puppeteer/Playwright)
Context hygiene: run > /context to prune unused MCP servers
Recurring loops: > /loop for polling & > /schedule for PR review
Keep CLAUDE.md under ~100 lines; move workflows to SKILL.md
Write tests → commit → code → iterate → commit
Tell it explicitly: 'we are doing TDD, do not write implementation
yet'. Then let it loop against the tests — this is where agents
claude "Write tests for the refresh race based on these cases;
don't implement yet. Confirm they fail."
Give it a way to see results (Puppeteer MCP, iOS simulator, or
pasted screenshots). Output quality jumps after 2-3 visual
claude "Implement this mock (pasted). Take a screenshot with the
Puppeteer tool and iterate until it matches."
Headless mode (-p) and /schedule run in CI; /desktop and separate
git worktrees let several Claude sessions work on independent tasks
claude -p "Triage this issue and label it" --output-format stream-
Never let it code first. Goal + Effort (/effort high) + Check ('Check it works in Chrome') → Explore → Plan → Code → Commit & fold repeat fixes into CLAUDE.md or a skill.
